series.label: van der Meer et al. 2022

series.label: Miller et al. 2020
series.method: deep-sea oxygen isotopes and Mg/Ca, checked against continental margins
series.source: Miller et al. 2020, Science Advances 6; PANGAEA
series.note: Smoothed. The authors flag Mg/Ca records older than 48 Ma as less certain.

series.label: Bintanja & van de Wal 2008
series.method: ice-sheet model driven by the LR04 oxygen-isotope stack
series.source: Bintanja & van de Wal 2008, Nature 454; NOAA
series.licence: NOAA World Data Service; cite the publication
series.note: The source gives the fall below today; it is shown here as height above.

series.label: Spratt & Lisiecki 2016
series.method: stack of five sea-level records from deep-sea oxygen isotopes
series.source: Spratt & Lisiecki 2016, Climate of the Past 12; NOAA
series.licence: NOAA World Data Service; cite the publication
series.note: The stack reads about +9 m at 0 ka: its zero is not today's sea level.
